operation: River may merge this partial data through the existing ballot publication path with the latest held state, preserving unrelated contests, candidate facts and explanations. This preparation performs no production writes.
coverage: All 14 pages of Harris County's official November 3, 2026 General and Special Elections composite sample were acquired and parsed. This packet covers 137 judicial/local candidate contests (270 printed named choices) and all 38 printed local measure questions. Federal, statewide executive, statewide Supreme Court/Criminal Appeals, State Board of Education, and legislative fields are preserved in parsed-all.json and are outside this local install.

Six unopposed seats declared elected (Crosby ISD districts 1/3/4/5 and North Harris County Regional Water Authority districts 2/3) are recorded in declared-elected.json rather than fabricated voting contests. The separate official notice names 31 cancelled elections.

The official declared-write-in list is preserved separately: 14 names across six office fields, including County Judge (2) and County Commissioner Precinct 4 (1). Blank Write-in spaces are excluded from printed candidate totals. Reader representation of declared write-ins remains open.

Composite coverage describes only elections administered and printed by Harris County. It does not prove every independent jurisdiction touching Harris County contracted with the county or held an election. No whole-county completeness is asserted.

Every source-printed electorate is retained separately. The checked-in reader registry does not resolve the precise IDs listed in unresolved-reader-divisions.json; the live registry has not been checked here. Reader division or boundary links remain open until resolved. No precinct, council district, water-authority director district, township, or special district is widened to the county or a CDP.
